Before dawn / Good to know

Before you clock in.

Start with the basics.

What is FiveM?

FiveM lets you play GTA V on community multiplayer servers. Florida RP is a roleplay community using FiveM. Start with the official FiveM installation guide ↗ for current setup instructions.

How do I join Florida RP?

Start with the Florida RP Discord ↗. Read the rules, check the current joining instructions and any access requirements, then use the server details provided there to connect through FiveM. Ask the team if anything is unclear.

What do I need to play?

You need GTA V on PC and FiveM. Follow the official installation guide and check with the Florida RP team which game edition and server requirements apply before you connect.

Is this an official GTA or FiveM website?

No. Florida RP is an independent community. This website is not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive or Cfx.re.

Can I buy a rank or membership now?

Not yet. The team is still discussing the tiers. Names, benefits, prices, and durations will be published here once confirmed.

Is VIP the same as a paid tier?

VIP is a community role, separate from the membership options being discussed. Ask the team on Discord for current eligibility and benefits; this website does not promise a paid package or automatic VIP access.

Where do I get help with my setup?

Ask for help in the Florida RP Discord. Explain which joining step failed and include any error message. Don't post passwords, account details or private information.
